title: Yellowed Golden Filipino Eggs Frittata
description: A savory and festive Filipino dish featuring free-range eggs, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly frittata is perfect for any meal, with a beautiful yellowed golden glaze on top.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the shredded cheese and chopped tomatoes to the skillet and stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese and tomato mixture in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the top is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet and slide it onto a plate.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
